priceNote: 52-week range $5.65-$22.17; well off highs, drifting into the Q3 print
summary: SoundHound reports Q3 2026 earnings on Nov 5, 2026 (confirmed). Its own last two prints show exactly how binary the reaction can be: Q1 2026 beat EPS but the stock fell -7.8% same day (-16% over the week) on dilution/offering concerns, while Q2 2026 beat and the stock jumped +15.4% after hours on clean guidance. Consensus target $12.71 (8 analysts, S&P Global; wider avg $13.29) implies +57.7% upside from $8.06. Base case (+35%) assumes a Q2-style clean beat and is well above the core lane's realized 14d P75 of +6.6% — the gap reflects a longer, multi-week re-rating horizon through and past the print, not the fixed measurement window, and the driver is guidance credibility, not just the EPS beat itself.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Confirmed Nov 5, 2026 after close. The key swing factor per SoundHound's own history is guidance credibility and dilution risk, not just whether EPS beats — a clean beat with no new equity-offering overhang is what drove the +15.4% Q2 reaction.

risks: A clean EPS beat is not sufficient on its own — Q1 2026 beat but fell -7.8% same day (-16% over the week) on dilution/equity-offering concerns
Still unprofitable with negative FCF — a hawkish Fed (rates just hiked to 3.75-4.00%) raises the cost of any future capital raise, and SOUN has a recent history of raising into weakness
High short interest and retail-driven flows can amplify moves sharply in either direction around the print
Competition from platform incumbents (Google, Amazon, in-house OEM voice stacks) is intensifying in SoundHound's core automotive and restaurant verticals

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16, 2026 (first hike since 2023); next FOMC is Oct 27-28, 2026 — just 8 days before SOUN's Nov 5 print, so a hawkish tone there could compress risk appetite right before the catalyst.
macroRisk.inflationNote: The hike responds to elevated inflation, not a growth scare, but unprofitable small-cap tech is exactly the cohort most sensitive to a higher discount rate and tighter capital-markets access.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI-software names with negative FCF have been volatile on any dilution headline in 2026 — SOUN's own Q1 print is the case study — and a hawkish Fed makes the next raise more expensive if guidance disappoints.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH macro risk — SOUN is unprofitable and dilution-prone, and the Oct 27-28 FOMC lands just over a week before the Q3 print, adding a macro wildcard on top of an already binary earnings setup.

entryStrategy.verdict: Measured median at-catalyst return across the core lane is -6.9% (n=54) — buying at today's $8.06 is not the default entry; the $6.90-7.20 pre-earnings dip is preferred. SoundHound's own history shows the print itself is binary (Q1: beat but -7.8%; Q2: beat and +15.4%) — the swing factor is guidance/dilution credibility, not the EPS line, so size for that binary outcome.

catalystSpot.preRunup: High-short-interest AI names like SOUN typically see a modest pre-print drift as positioning builds, though SOUN's own history shows the print outcome swings hard on guidance credibility rather than the setup

postWin.note: SoundHound's own last two prints: Q2 2026 (Aug 2026) beat on EPS (-$0.02 vs -$0.05 est.) and revenue ($61.9M vs $52.4M est.), stock +15.4% after-hours on clean guidance. Q1 2026 (May 2026) also beat EPS by 40% but fell -7.8% same day / -16% over the week on dilution/equity-offering concerns — included here because it shows a beat alone doesn't guarantee the 'win' outcome.

postLose.note: SOUN's Q1 2026 print: EPS beat by 40% but the stock still fell -7.79% same day and -16% over the following week, driven by concerns about dilution from a planned equity offering rather than the numbers themselves.

macroRisk.inflationNote: การขึ้นดอกเบี้ยมาจากเงินเฟ้อ ไม่ใช่สัญญาณเศรษฐกิจถดถอย แต่หุ้นเทคโนโลยีขนาดเล็กที่ยังไม่มีกำไรไวต่อ discount rate ที่สูงขึ้นและการเข้าถึงตลาดทุนที่ยากขึ้นมากที่สุด

macroRisk.summary: ความเสี่ยง Fed ระดับ HIGH — SOUN ยังไม่มีกำไรและมีความเสี่ยง dilution สูง ประกอบกับ FOMC 27-28 ต.ค. อยู่ก่อนงบ Q3 แค่กว่าสัปดาห์เดียว เพิ่มตัวแปร macro เข้าไปในสถานการณ์ที่ binary อยู่แล้ว

entryStrategy.verdict: ผลตอบแทนเฉลี่ย ณ วัน catalyst ของ core lane อยู่ที่ -6.9% (n=54) — การซื้อที่ราคาปัจจุบัน $8.06 จึงไม่ใช่ทางเลือกหลัก ควรรอโซน $6.90-7.20 ก่อนงบ ประวัติของ SoundHound เองแสดงว่าปฏิกิริยาต่องบเป็น binary (Q1: เกินคาดแต่ -7.8%; Q2: เกินคาดและ +15.4%) — ปัจจัยชี้ขาดคือความน่าเชื่อถือของ guidance ไม่ใช่ตัวเลขกำไร จึงควรจัดขนาด position ให้เหมาะกับผลลัพธ์แบบ binary
